notes: Independent review REV-PAPER-ZHU-17 by Claude Code, session cc-2aeb03; the extraction was written by Codex (codex-c83e7a) and completed by Claude Code (cc-442dc5, #2123). The published Annals version (90 pages, pp. 403–492; hash matching) was read in full on page images in seven ranges against every item, with arXiv v2 and v3 compared where recorded mistakes concern them. Corrected in place: 163 item fields (88 statements, 74 locators, 1 name) and 10 notes; item G29e removed as a duplicate of G24; 104 items added for definitions, constructions and cited inputs the proofs use; three Part II titles set to their parents' exact atlas titles; the briefs of routes 15, 17 and 18 and the items of the source routes carry the confirmed corrections; prerequisites rebuilt as 23 cited works with DOIs or stable links. Statuses: all library declarations opened at the pinned commits and all planned stages checked. Mistakes: of the extraction's 34, E18 is rejected on review (Liu–Yun do derive the theorem as described) and the rest are confirmed, 15 revised as the independent checks upheld (E1 a gap in arXiv v2 fixed in v3; E27 worse than recorded: the top-degree trace depends on the model up to powers of p). 44 new claims were checked a second time, independently: 37 confirmed, 5 reclassified, 2 rejected; one was folded into another, and the rest are E35–E75. The main new ones: Theorem 3.10(3) fails when {μ} is not defined over Q_p unless b is taken in G(W)σ(μ)(p)G(W) (E64); errors in the proofs of Corollary 2.10 (E51), Lemma 2.11 (E53) and Lemma 2.32 (E58), and in Proposition 2.5's refinement (E46); gaps in Lemmas 1.3 and 1.5 (E38, E39), Corollary 2.8 (E48) and the twisted trace formula (E61). The geometric Satake equivalence and the dimension formula stand.
